limits: this measures offline PNG-to-GIF encoding, not capture or stop-to-preview latency
per-frame centisecond delays and infinite-loop metadata must match the fixture/output contract
peak workspace bytes are polled every 20 ms and can miss short-lived files

macOS /usr/bin/time -l reports command CPU/RSS when available; otherwise /usr/bin/time -p reports user/system CPU and sampled ps sums RSS for the timer process and descendants, which can miss short peaks
GIF parsing checks structure and metadata, not visual fidelity or playback in another app
